# ScribeCat 0.25.4

## Fixed
- Remove the PDF minimap to reduce rendering and scroll overhead.
- Make desktop drag-to-pan work on zoomed PDFs while preserving native text selection on actual text.
- Smooth wheel, trackpad and pinch zoom by using immediate visual scaling and delayed high-resolution rerendering.
- Keep pointer-anchored zoom and reliable reset to 100%.

## Docker
- Publish the corrected frontend/server build as `ghcr.io/reidar96/scribecat-server:0.25.4`.
- Update the Server Edition Compose default to `0.25.4`.
